quick.story: Einstein did not discover new ideas only by memorizing formulas. He imagined impossible situations and asked what would happen if the usual rules were stretched.

bigIdea.title: Think in possibilities first
bigIdea.explanation: Big breakthroughs often begin with a what-if question, not a final answer.

thinkingTool.name: Run a thought experiment
thinkingTool.instruction: Imagine a situation with one rule changed. Follow the consequences logically.

modernTest.scenario: Your team is using AI to draft reports, summarize meetings, and generate ideas. You wonder what human thinking is still for.
modernTest.question: What would Einstein ask first?

options.label: What kind of thinking will still matter when answers are easy?
options.explanation: This imagines a changed world instead of panicking.

options.label: Which app gives the fastest answers?
options.explanation: This focuses on tools, not thinking.

modernTest.discussionNotes: Einstein would ask what new mental skill becomes important when old shortcuts disappear.

quick.reflectionPrompt: Imagine one impossible idea that could improve your work, community, or daily life. Explain how it might work.

thoughtTension.counterView: But imagination without facts is just fantasy, right?
thoughtTension.responsePrompt: How can imagination and evidence work together?

full.story: Einstein became one of history's greatest scientists not because he memorized more facts than everyone else, but because he asked strange what-if questions. He imagined riding on a beam of light, then followed the consequences carefully.

bigIdea.title: Think in possibilities first
bigIdea.explanation: Breakthrough thinking often begins with imagination, then gets tested by logic and evidence.

thinkingTool.name: Run a thought experiment
thinkingTool.instruction: Imagine a situation with one rule changed. Follow the consequences logically.

options.label: What happens to curiosity if answers become automatic?

options.label: How do we ban the tool completely?

options.label: What new kind of thinking becomes valuable in an AI world?
options.explanation: This uses imagination to redefine the problem.
